content:
ashwin: quick brain-dump — i want to propose a "micro-rung" canary primitive for model upgrades. goal: many small percent steps + safety holdpoints + telemetry hooks. looking for API shape + sane defaults.

maria: +1. do you mean something like 1 -> 5 -> 10 -> 25 -> 50? or smaller granularity? curious about default min_duration per step.

ashwin: yeah similar but i think we should bias toward finer early steps for low-risk detection. initial idea: [1,3,7,15,35,60]. min_duration default: 15m for first 3, 30m for mid, 1h for large steps.

jordan: want to call out statistical power: if our p95 latency SLO is rare, 1% traffic for 15m may not produce useful signals. we need sampling rules + a min-observations-per-step. eg min_requests=2000 or min_duration whichever longer.

sophie: agreed. also add explicit SLO gate definitions in the config. e.g. p95_latency: rel_increase_threshold=10%(over baseline), error_rate: absolute_threshold=1%. when exceeded -> auto-pause.

ashwin: putting that together, a draft config (json) for API: 

```
{
  "strategy": "micro_rungs",
  "steps": [
    {"percent":1,  "min_duration":"15m", "min_samples":2000},
    {"percent":3,  "min_duration":"15m", "min_samples":2000},
    {"percent":7,  "min_duration":"15m", "min_samples":3000},
    {"percent":15, "min_duration":"30m", "min_samples":5000},
    {"percent":35, "min_duration":"1h",  "min_samples":10000},
    {"percent":60, "min_duration":"2h",  "min_samples":20000}
  ],
  "slo_checks": [
    {"metric":"p95_latency","rel_increase_pct":10, "action":"pause"},
    {"metric":"error_rate","absolute_threshold":0.01, "action":"rollback"}
  ],
  "fallback_policy":"previous_variant",
  "max_total_duration":"6h",
  "notify_on":"pause,rollback,complete"
}
```

maria: config looks good. small nit: fallback_policy enum should include "canary-fallback" if we want gradual degrade (route to a cheaper quantized variant) rather than full rollback.

jordan: one more thing: we need telemetry windowing semantics. for each step we should compute rolling windows + compare to baseline windows. baseline should be smoothed (rolling 6h) and optionally anchored to pre-deploy snapshot.

sophie: agree. and we'd better include a minimum relative traffic share for cohort-targeted rollouts (e.g., if user targets country=DE but that's only 0.2% of traffic, block the step unless override).

devex-sam: UI implications — console needs: 1) visualize the rung progression timeline, 2) show per-step sample counts and confidence intervals, 3) allow forced-advance/force-pause with an audit log, 4) presets (safe / fast / experimental).

ashwin: yes — presets: "safe" = finer steps + higher min_samples, "fast" = coarser steps + lower min_samples, "exp" = no auto-rollback (for internal testing only).

ops-bot: deploy-checker: when a step starts we will emit: "ramp_step.start" events with {step_percent, step_idx, start_ts}. when a step ends: "ramp_step.complete" with stats {requests,successes,p95}.

jordan: do we want automatic rollback on signaled regressions or auto-pause only and require human ack for rollback? auto-rollback is riskier for false positives. i'd prefer pause + ticket to oncall; rollback optional with stronger thresholds.

sophie: +1. default should be pause. auto-rollback can be an opt-in flag if you've validated your eval harness.

maria: what about A/B experiments vs canary? the API shape should reuse the same step primitives but expose different traffic selectors. canary = sequential ramp for all traffic; ab-test = simultaneous split groups with metrics comparator. maybe share "step" schema but different controller.

ashwin: good call. reuse schema for step defs and slo_checks. controller field = {"sequential" | "parallel"}.

devex-sam: small UX ask — add a live-safety-overlay on top of model detail page showing current cohort health and active rungs with green/amber/red. engineers should be able to click a rung and see the raw sample bucket.

jordan: telemetry detail: add bootstrapped CIs for delta estimates and a 'min-signal-to-noise' requirement before making decisions. otherwise pause and label as "insufficient data".

ashwin: ok action items: (1) i'll draft a proto API PR for the rollout config (json schema + validation) — target EOD Thu. (2) @devex-sam please mock two console presets (safe/fast) and a rung visualization. (3) @jordan + @sophie define exact SLO gate numeric defaults and min-samples for p95 and error. (4) ops team: add ramp_step events to telemetry contract.

maria: lgtm. if anyone objects to default pause-on-slo-breach, speak now. otherwise i'll add this to the design doc. :thumbsup:

ashwin: no objections. thanks all.

ops-bot: reminder: please follow deploy-runbook for manual rollbacks: https://internal.redwood/deploys/runbook#rollback
